notes.title: Ninja Party: What’s Next — New Mode, iOS Release & Bug Fixes | NinJournal #1
notes.notes:
Welcome to #NinJournal — our new dev log where we share future plans and behind-the-scenes stories. 


Today, our producer is here to tell you what’s coming in the next updates, ninja-bro!



TL;DR for the laziest ninjas: 

Bug fixes — we’re aware of the matchmaking and performance issues and are actively working on them.  

New “Blitz” mode — ultra-fast matches with no boring downtime between rounds.  

iOS version — polishing the build, launching alongside Blitz mode.  

Progression — leveling up will be easier, and rewards will come faster. 



Read the full post here:

https://ninjaparty.com/news/ninjournal-1-whats-next-new-mode-ios-release-bug-fixes/

 

And tell us in the comments what you think about Blitz!
